description: Feature-planning records actionable Out of Scope entries as discovered work and leaves boundary statements alone.
failure_mode: Model leaves actionable follow-up work only in plan prose, where it is lost, or records pure boundary statements as noise.
prompt: Planning issue #430 (add a `--json` flag to `nightgauge discovered-work list`). Your Out of Scope section has two entries: (A) "no UI changes" and (B) "list output is unbounded; add pagination", which no issue tracks. Which do you record as discovered work? End your answer with a single ```json fenced block containing exactly this object, with one value chosen for each field: {"record_entry_a": true | false, "record_entry_b": true | false, "source_stage": "feature-planning" | "feature-dev" | "none", "cite_dw_id_in_plan": true | false}
